page_title: BAY 3-0 FRE | Bayern Munich v Freiburg 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+2' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Corner kick. Freiburg will have an opportunity.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.

89' A big opportunity is wasted by Frans Kratzig (Bayern Munich), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Noah Atubolu pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
88' Thomas Tuchel decides to make a substitution. Joshua Kimmich will be replaced by Frans Kratzig (Bayern Munich).
88' Today's match ends for Kingsley Coman who will be replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).
87' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
85' 3 - 0 Goal! Konrad Laimer passes the ball to Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Noah Atubolu couldn't do anything about it. 3:0.
84' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Roland Sallai and he is replaced by Maximilian Breunig (Freiburg).
84' Here comes a substitution. Maximilian Eggestein is given a rest as he is replaced by Fabian Rudlin (Freiburg).

83' What a great touch by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) after latching on to a precise pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and rips a shot close to the right post. The goalkeeper makes an astonishing save, knocking the ball onto the post.
81' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
77' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) replacing Dayot Upamecano.
77' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
75' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Thomas Muller walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich).
72' Thomas Tuchel prepares a substitution. Harry Kane is replaced by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
71' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Noah Atubolu is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
69' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) latches onto a loose ball inside the box, but his first-time strike at goal is blocked by a defender.
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Lucas Holer as he is replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
68' Christian Streich has decided to make a change. Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) replaces Ritsu Doan.
68' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) runs onto a ball from Joshua Kimmich and tries an ambitious shot from mid-range. The keeper has it covered but it goes just over the bar anyway.
67' Total attempts – 14:1. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:0.
64' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches on to an accurate cross inside the box and quickly shoots, but unluckily for him one of his own teammates gets in the way of the ball and blocks the shot.
62' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
60' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

59' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' The ball is cleared after Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
57' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way past the left post.
55' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
55' Some great controlled play and passing from Bayern Munich. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
53' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

53' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
51' Half-chance! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) plays a pass into the box, but Noah Atubolu reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
48' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) is replaced by Maximilian Philipp.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bayern Munich due to an offside in the build-up play.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' The Bayern Munich players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Schroder makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

44' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Noah Atubolu is just a bystander as the ball flies into the top left corner. The score is 3:0.
42' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Robert Schroder who sees an offensive foul.
41' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

39' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
35' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
32' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
29' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) plays a one-two with Leon Goretzka, but the move breaks down.
29' 6:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. 2:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
25' 2 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane passes the ball to the feet of Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 2:0.
22' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
21' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) tries to find Leroy Sane, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
19' Leroy Sane links up with Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who fires just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
17' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
15' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Schroder no option but to blow his whistle.
14' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
14' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) brings an opponent down and Robert Schroder interrupts the game. Freiburg have a free kick.

12' 1 - 0 What a phenomenal goal! Thomas Muller sends a pass onto Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) who unleashes a spectacular long-range shot and scores! The ball goes in off the left post, leaving the goalkeeper stranded. 1:0.

9' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) superbly chips the ball over a defender inside the box to feed Leroy Sane in stride, but one of the defenders manages to clear the ball. The ball unexpectedly rebounds out to Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box, but his attempt is lame and ends up well wide of the right post.
9' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
6' Roland Sallai releases Lucas Holer (Freiburg) with a pass, he composes himself and shoots from mid-range but the ball curls well wide of the right post.
6' Freiburg keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
4' The corner kick from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
3' The corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by the defence.
3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and Bayern Munich manage to earn a corner.
2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

2' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
1' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Bayern Munich will take the kick-off.
Robert Schroder is the one to supervise the game today.
